incidents.name: BurgerSwap DemaxPair missing k invariant
incidents.notes: DemaxPair.swap() omits Uniswap V2's constant-product require entirely and only checks that some input arrived, trusting the onlyPlatform router's amount maths, so re-entering the router through an attacker-issued fake token mid-path let the BURGER/WBNB pair be swapped past its invariant.

sources.ref: onchain review: I read the verified DemaxPair source at 0x7ac55ac5 - swap() has no balanceAdjusted/k require, only 'INSUFFICIENT_INPUT_AMOUNT'; pair created 2020-09-19 by 0xbc554d0fa1745aeb52acba8343106cf8aca038ca (same deployer as DemaxPlatform), not by attack sender 0x6c9f2b95
